subject: English First Additional Language
lesson_scope: English First Additional Language (Foundation Phase only)

terms.theme: Orientation - This is me; Orientation - My birthday; We go to school; My family; We play outside; We have feelings

topics.name: Listening and Speaking
subtopics: Theme: Orientation - This is me
Greets learners and has them greet a friend; teaches the daily routine
Vocabulary: I, feel, happy, sad; 'same' and 'different' taught through actions

topics.name: Reading (Shared Reading)
subtopics: Looks at a picture (DBE Workbook 1 p.2) and listens to a short story about children greeting at the playground
Answers simple questions about the story ('Who says hello?', 'Who feels happy?')

topics.name: Phonics
subtopics: Attention getter routine ('1-2-3 eyes on me'); learners stop talking and respond

topics.name: Writing
subtopics: Draws self and writes own name (DBE Workbook 1 p.5), with teacher modelling on the board

topics.name: Listening and Speaking
subtopics: Theme: Orientation - My birthday
Routine for moving to the carpet and back (rhyme 'Come to the carpet')
Song 'Happy birthday to you'; question: 'Which colour do you like most?'
Vocabulary: six, seven, eight years old; 'more' and 'fewer'

topics.name: Reading (Shared Reading)
subtopics: First read of a birthday story (DBE Workbook 1 p.8), explained with code-switching

topics.name: Phonics
subtopics: Second attention getter ('If you can hear me clap once')

topics.name: Writing
subtopics: Draws own family

topics.name: Listening and Speaking
subtopics: Theme: We go to school
Daily routine: greeting, theme song or rhyme with actions, open-ended question of the day, 4 vocabulary words a day and weekly sight words
Songs: 'If you are happy and you know it'; 'Look who came to school today' with actions
Vocabulary e.g. backpack, school, favourite, friend, teacher, classroom, uniform, pencil, learn, bus, walk, desk
Sight words: I, like, to, play; all, day, at, school

topics.name: Reading (Shared Reading)
subtopics: Shared Reading routine: pre-read, first read, learners illustrate the story, second read, post-read recount
Week 4: learners recount the part of the story they liked most

topics.name: Phonics
subtopics: Environmental sounds: listens to two sounds (clap, whistle, click, tap) and says whether they are the same or different

topics.name: Writing
subtopics: Week 3: 'I feel...' - draws how they feel at school
Week 4: 'I like...' - draws something they like at school

topics.name: Listening and Speaking
subtopics: Theme: My family
Daily routine: greeting, theme song or rhyme with actions, open-ended question of the day, 4 vocabulary words a day and weekly sight words
Songs: 'Some families are big'; 'This is a family' finger rhyme
Vocabulary e.g. family, brother, sister, baby, grandparents, help, clean, younger, older, sibling
Sight words: Mom, Dad, and, my; have, a big, family

topics.name: Reading (Shared Reading)
subtopics: Shared Reading routine: pre-read, first read, learners illustrate the story, second read, post-read recount
Week 5: visualises during the first read and makes inferences in the second read
Week 6: recounts one thing remembered from the story

topics.name: Phonics
subtopics: Week 5: environmental sounds, same or different
Week 6: introduces /a/ (ant, apple, axe, animal) with the song 'ants on my arm'

topics.name: Writing
subtopics: Week 5: 'My family is...' - draws their family
Week 6: draws something they like to do with their family

topics.name: Listening and Speaking
subtopics: Theme: We play outside
Daily routine: greeting, theme song or rhyme with actions, open-ended question of the day, 4 vocabulary words a day and weekly sight words
Songs: 'I'm bouncing'; 'I see sunshine' (spring) with actions
Vocabulary e.g. ball, kick, throw, playground, slide, swings, season, summer, winter, spring, wet, dry
Sight words: we, in, the, sun; do, you, hot, run

topics.name: Reading (Shared Reading)
subtopics: Shared Reading routine: pre-read, first read, learners illustrate the story, second read, post-read recount
Week 8: visualises in the first read; recounts the story

topics.name: Phonics
subtopics: Week 7: introduces /s/ (snake, snail, sand, sun) with song; revises a and s
Week 8: introduces /t/ (tap, tiger, not, spot); differentiates t and s; teacher models segmenting and blending (tap, sat, mat)

topics.name: Writing
subtopics: Week 7: 'I like to...' - draws something they like doing outside
Week 8: 'I like to play...' - draws a place they like to be outside

topics.name: Listening and Speaking
subtopics: Theme: We have feelings
Daily routine: greeting, theme song or rhyme with actions, open-ended question of the day, 4 vocabulary words a day and weekly sight words
Songs: 'Sometimes on my face you'll see'; 'If you're angry and you know it'
Vocabulary e.g. sad, mad, embarrassed, grumpy, mood, excited, scared, worried, polite, rude, syllable, clap
Sight words: am, sad, he, said; is, so, happy, she

topics.name: Reading (Shared Reading)
subtopics: Pre-read prediction; first read making connections or inferences; illustrates and recounts the story

topics.name: Phonics
subtopics: Week 9: introduces /p/ (path, pencil, map, clap); rhyming words (pat, sat, tap); differentiates s and p; segments and blends words
Week 10: environmental sound patterns copied from the teacher; rhyming words

topics.name: Writing
subtopics: Week 9: 'I felt grumpy when...' - draws a time they felt grumpy
Week 10: 'I felt scared when...' - draws a time they felt scared

sba: Listening and speaking (by week 9; rubric, 1 score on SA-SAMS): points to and names objects in the classroom or a picture on instruction; responds to a simple question. Checklist: responds to greetings, sings songs with actions, makes simple requests
Phonics oral (by week 9; rubric): reproduces sound patterns using environmental sounds. Checklist: begins to identify initial sounds; identifies some rhyming words
Reading oral (by week 9; rubric/checklist): answers simple oral questions about a story; joins in choruses after repeated readings; identifies people, animals and objects in illustrations
Writing (observed, not recorded on SA-SAMS): draws a picture for a story that is told; copies a caption for a picture

terms.theme: Friends; Growing things; Animals; Sports and games; The three little pigs

topics.name: Listening and Speaking
subtopics: Theme: Friends
Daily routine: greeting, theme song or rhyme with actions, open-ended question of the day, 4 vocabulary words a day and weekly sight words
Songs: 'If you want to be a friend, clap your hands'; 'Make new friends'
Vocabulary e.g. friend, share, kind, unkind, shy, joke, argue, jealous, proud, apologise, sorry
Sight words: my, very, good, friend; they, are, and, love
Uses the simple present tense in context

topics.name: Reading (Shared Reading)
subtopics: Shared Reading routine: pre-read, first read, learners illustrate the story, second read, post-read recount (daily Monday-Friday)
Week 1: recounts the part of the story they liked most

topics.name: Phonics
subtopics: Week 1: revises Term 1 sounds; /i/ (it, sit, pit, tip); differentiates p and i; segments oral sentences into words
Week 2: /n/ (nap, nip, pin, tin); differentiates i and n; segments oral sentences into words

topics.name: Writing
subtopics: Week 1: 'My friend is...' - draws self with best friend
Week 2: 'We like to...' - draws something they like to do with friends

topics.name: Listening and Speaking
subtopics: Theme: Growing things
Daily routine: greeting, theme song or rhyme with actions, open-ended question of the day, 4 vocabulary words a day and weekly sight words
Songs: 'This is my garden'; 'Here is a little seed'
Vocabulary e.g. seed, grow, plant, soil, rain, flour, bread, garden, tomatoes, carrots, spinach, seedling, dig
Sight words: there, little, red, hen; saw, didn't, that, worm

topics.name: Reading (Shared Reading)
subtopics: Shared Reading routine: pre-read, first read, learners illustrate the story, second read, post-read recount
Learners recount the part of the story they liked most

topics.name: Phonics
subtopics: Week 3: /m/ (mat, man, mop, met); differentiates m and n; segments oral sentences into words
Week 4: /h/ (hut, hen, hat, hit); differentiates d and h; claps out syllables in familiar words

topics.name: Writing
subtopics: Week 3: 'I want to grow...' - draws something they would like to grow
Week 4: 'My garden is full of...' - draws their garden

topics.name: Listening and Speaking
subtopics: Theme: Animals
Daily routine: greeting, theme song or rhyme with actions, open-ended question of the day, 4 vocabulary words a day and weekly sight words
Songs: 'Elephants have rough grey skin'; 'This is the way we milk the cow'
Vocabulary e.g. stripes, spots, leopard, zebra, fur, claw, elephant, tail, cow, chicken, farmer, sheep, goat, tractor
Sight words: see, some, pretty, birds; can, small, pig, cow

topics.name: Reading (Shared Reading)
subtopics: Shared Reading routine: pre-read, first read, learners illustrate the story, second read, post-read recount
Week 5: visualises and makes inferences; recounts part of the story
Week 6: recounts one thing remembered from the story

topics.name: Phonics
subtopics: Week 5: /o/ (on, mop, top, pot); differentiates d and o; claps out syllables
Week 6: /b/ (bed, bat, beg, bin, bun); differentiates b and h; identifies rhyming words

topics.name: Writing
subtopics: Week 5: 'I want to see...' - draws a wild animal they would like to see
Week 6: 'My favourite animal is...' - draws their favourite animal

topics.name: Listening and Speaking
subtopics: Theme: Sports and games
Daily routine: greeting, theme song or rhyme with actions, open-ended question of the day, 4 vocabulary words a day and weekly sight words
Songs: 'I'm out on the field' (soccer); 'Fasten your laces' (athletics)
Vocabulary e.g. ball, kick, catch, field, team, cricket, netball, throw, hit, rule, goal, score, win
Sight words: do, want, with, me; what, game, should, today

topics.name: Reading (Shared Reading)
subtopics: Shared Reading routine: pre-read, first read, learners illustrate the story, second read, post-read recount
Recounts or acts out part of the story

topics.name: Phonics
subtopics: Week 7: /c/ (cat, cop, cap, can); differentiates c and o; identifies rhyming words
Week 8: /k/ (kin, kit, kid); differentiates o and k; identifies initial sounds (names of peers and objects)

topics.name: Writing
subtopics: Week 7: 'I want to play...' - draws a sport they like to play
Week 8: 'I play games with...' - draws who they like to play games with

topics.name: Listening and Speaking
subtopics: Theme: The three little pigs
Daily routine: greeting, theme song or rhyme with actions, open-ended question of the day, 4 vocabulary words a day and weekly sight words
Chants: 'Little pigs, little pigs, let me in!'; 'Little mouse, little mouse, let me in!'
Vocabulary e.g. house, sticks, bricks, wolf, chase, huff, puff, character, first, second, third, nest, reed, whiskers
Sight words: think, three, pigs, funny; read, all, about, mice

topics.name: Reading (Shared Reading)
subtopics: Shared Reading routine: pre-read, first read, learners illustrate the story, second read, post-read recount
Recounts or acts out the story

topics.name: Phonics
subtopics: Week 9: /e/ (set, net, pet, ten, pen); differentiates k and e; identifies initial sounds
Week 10: revises a, s, t, p, i, n, d, f, k, c, e, o; builds CVC words (f-i-n, c-a-t, s-i-t); segments and blends

topics.name: Writing
subtopics: Week 9: 'I want to build...' - draws the house they want to build
Week 10: 'The three little... and the big bad...' - completes and illustrates the frame

sba: Listening and speaking (by week 9; rubric out of 10): responds to simple questions and oral instructions; points to and names objects on instruction. Checklist: understands term vocabulary (greetings and farewells), sings songs with actions, expresses self with short phrases
Phonics oral (by week 9; rubric out of 5): claps out syllables in familiar words. Checklist: segments oral sentences into words; identifies rhyming words; identifies initial sounds

Reading oral (by week 9; rubric out of 10): listens and responds to a story told or read; joins in choruses. Checklist: answers simple questions about a story or non-fiction text; points to objects in pictures to show vocabulary
Writing (observed, not recorded on SA-SAMS): copies a caption for own drawing and reads it back

terms.theme: All around town; Working together; Clothes; Reading is fun; Keeping our bodies healthy and safe

topics.name: Listening and Speaking
subtopics: Theme: All around town
Daily routine: greeting, theme song or rhyme with actions, open-ended question of the day, 4 vocabulary words a day and weekly sight words
Songs: 'We'll be going into town on the bus'; 'Turn left, turn right... to the library in town'
Vocabulary e.g. taxi, passenger, town, street, bus stop, clinic, driver, petrol station, sidewalk, safe, unsafe, warning
Sight words: drives, taxi, around, all; together, friend, shop, sister
Uses a few adjectives in context; identifies a person, animal or object from a simple oral description

topics.name: Reading (Shared Reading)
subtopics: Shared Reading routine: pre-read, first read, learners illustrate the story, second read, post-read recount
Week 1: recounts the part of the story they liked most; Week 2: draws the story

topics.name: Phonics
subtopics: Week 1: revises Term 2 sounds; 'ck' (sick, pack, sock, kick); rhyming words (pack/sack)
Week 2: /g/ (gap, gas, got, gun); differentiates ck and g; claps syllables in familiar words

topics.name: Writing
subtopics: Week 1: 'I like to go...' - draws a place they like to go in town
Week 2: 'I go to town' - draws themselves going to town

topics.name: Listening and Speaking
subtopics: Theme: Working together
Daily routine: greeting, theme song or rhyme with actions, open-ended question of the day, 4 vocabulary words a day and weekly sight words
Songs: 'The more we work together'; 'If we work together'
Vocabulary e.g. help, classmate, giant, beetroot, stuck, pull, strong, team, teamwork, mess, clean, fix, recycle, queue
Sight words: help, here, please, dog; they, work, pull, beetroot

topics.name: Reading (Shared Reading)
subtopics: Shared Reading routine: pre-read, first read, learners illustrate the story, second read, post-read recount
Learners recount the part of the story they liked most

topics.name: Phonics
subtopics: Week 3: /d/ (dad, dot, dog, dig); claps syllables in familiar words
Week 4: /u/ (sun, bun, hug, bug); segmenting and blending; differentiates u and g; rhyming words

topics.name: Writing
subtopics: Week 3: 'I work well with...' - draws the person they like working with
Week 4: 'My friend and I...' - draws a time they worked together with a friend

topics.name: Listening and Speaking
subtopics: Theme: Clothes
Daily routine: greeting, theme song or rhyme with actions, open-ended question of the day, 4 vocabulary words a day and weekly sight words
Songs: 'Children with a white shirt, please stand up'; 'I am special'
Vocabulary e.g. clothing, colours, boots, dress, pants, skirt, uniform, jersey, T-shirt, choose, buy, shopping, mirror
Sight words: up, down, boots, in; what, buy, two, shirts

topics.name: Reading (Shared Reading)
subtopics: Shared Reading routine: pre-read, first read, learners illustrate the story, second read, post-read recount
Week 5: visualises and makes inferences; recounts or acts out part of the story
Week 6: recounts one thing remembered from the story

topics.name: Phonics
subtopics: Week 5: /r/ (red, rat, rod, rip); segmenting and blending; differentiates r and n
Week 6: /f/ (fat, fit, fig, fin); segmenting and blending; differentiates r and f

topics.name: Writing
subtopics: Week 5: 'I love to wear...' - draws and lists clothing they like
Week 6: 'I want to buy... at the clothing shop!' - draws and lists new clothes

topics.name: Listening and Speaking
subtopics: Theme: Reading is fun
Daily routine: greeting, theme song or rhyme with actions, open-ended question of the day, 4 vocabulary words a day and weekly sight words
Songs: 'Stories are such fun'; 'I can learn some words by sight'
Vocabulary e.g. book, cover, story, title, author, page, character, picture, newspaper, comics, aloud, silent
Sight words: this, fun, book; read, wants, for, books

topics.name: Reading (Shared Reading)
subtopics: Shared Reading routine: pre-read, first read, learners illustrate the story, second read, post-read recount
Recounts or acts out a part of the story, then the whole story

topics.name: Phonics
subtopics: Week 7: /l/ (lip, lap, lot, lid); segmenting and blending; differentiates l and f
Week 8: plurals with -s (books, dogs, cats) and the function of -s

topics.name: Writing
subtopics: Week 7: 'I want to read a story about...' - draws the story they want to read
Week 8: 'I like to read with...' - draws the person they like reading with

topics.name: Listening and Speaking
subtopics: Theme: Keeping our bodies healthy and safe
Daily routine: greeting, theme song or rhyme with actions, open-ended question of the day, 4 vocabulary words a day and weekly sight words
Songs: 'Ride, ride, ride your bike' (helmet safety); 'I may be young'
Vocabulary e.g. body, helmet, bicycle, seatbelt, protect, healthy, sleep, brain, uncomfortable, secret, trust, brave
Sight words: wear, ride, helmet; tell, mother, father, feel

topics.name: Reading (Shared Reading)
subtopics: Pre-read prediction; first read; illustrates and recounts the story

topics.name: Phonics
subtopics: Week 9: plurals with -es (boxes, dishes, brushes, glasses) and the function of -es
Week 10: revision; 'll' (ball, call, hill); segmenting and blending

topics.name: Writing
subtopics: Week 9: 'My body is healthy when...' - draws and lists healthy habits (e.g. healthy food)
Week 10: 'I trust...' writing frame with a drawing
Writes simple lists with headings, with the teacher's help

sba: Listening and speaking (by week 9; rubric out of 10): identifies a person, animal or object from a simple oral description; points to and names objects to show vocabulary. Checklist: greetings and farewells, simple questions and instructions, songs with actions
Phonics oral (by week 9; rubric out of 5): recognises plurals (-s, -es) orally. Checklist: identifies initial sounds

Reading oral (by week 9; rubric out of 10): answers simple questions about a story; acts out the story using some dialogue. Checklist: listens and responds to a story, joins in choruses, names people, objects and animals in illustrations
Writing (observed, not recorded on SA-SAMS): writes a simple list with a heading (3-5 words on a topic)

terms.theme: Solving problems; We grow and change; Our living history; Science is fun; Consolidation and revision

topics.name: Listening and Speaking
subtopics: Theme: Solving problems
Daily routine: greeting, theme song or rhyme with actions, open-ended question of the day, 4 vocabulary words a day and weekly sight words
Songs: 'Every problem has a solution'; 'If there is a problem... ask someone for help'
Vocabulary e.g. problem, solve, creative, idea, artist, lose, find, try, wise, argue, share, fair, unfair, owner, tricky
Sight words: can't, find, but, it; tree, mine, no, that
Uses the modal 'can' in context ('I can...')

topics.name: Reading (Shared Reading)
subtopics: Week 1: predicts; makes inferences in first and second reads; recounts favourite part
Week 2: predicts; evaluates what is read and justifies it; makes inferences; acts out the story

topics.name: Phonics
subtopics: Week 1: revises Term 3 sounds; /j/ (jog, jam, jug, jet); sound differentiation; rhyming; claps syllables in names
Week 2: /v/ (vet, van, vat); sound differentiation; claps syllables in story words

topics.name: Writing
subtopics: Week 1: writing frame 'I could not find... So I...'
Week 2: writing frame 'I needed help when... ... helped me solve the problem.'

topics.name: Listening and Speaking
subtopics: Theme: We grow and change
Daily routine: greeting, theme song or rhyme with actions, open-ended question of the day, 4 vocabulary words a day and weekly sight words
Songs: 'We all grow and change every day'; 'Clothes I wore when I was small'
Vocabulary e.g. change, taller, smarter, feelings, comfortable, uncomfortable, season, winter, summer, spring, autumn, tight, grow
Sight words: grow, every, day, very; does, not, too, small
Question of the day e.g. 'What can you do now that you could not do as a baby?' (answers start 'I can...')

topics.name: Reading (Shared Reading)
subtopics: Week 3: predicts; makes connections to own experience; recounts or acts out the story
Week 4: predicts; visualises in first and second reads; recounts the story

topics.name: Phonics
subtopics: Week 3: /w/ (wag, wig, wet, wall, will); sound differentiation
Week 4: final /x/ (fox, box, fix, six); sound differentiation

topics.name: Writing
subtopics: Week 3: writing frame 'I feel happy and free when I... My... helps me feel happy and free!'
Week 4: writing frame 'I used to wear my... Now it...'

topics.name: Listening and Speaking
subtopics: Theme: Our living history
Daily routine: greeting, theme song or rhyme with actions, open-ended question of the day, 4 vocabulary words a day and weekly sight words
Songs: 'What do you know about history?'; 'If you know your family history clap your hands'
Vocabulary e.g. history, past, present, future, neighbourhood, memory, remember, tradition, Ramadan, ingredients, dough, great-grandmother
Sight words: family, special, your, about; mother, her, bakes, Friday

topics.name: Reading (Shared Reading)
subtopics: Week 5: predicts; searches the text for simple details; makes inferences; recounts or acts out the story
Week 6: predicts; makes connections; recounts or acts out the story

topics.name: Phonics
subtopics: Week 5: initial /y/ (yes, yet, yum); sound differentiation; claps syllables in sight words
Week 6: final -y (my, cry, why, fly, sky); rhyming words; claps syllables in sight words

topics.name: Writing
subtopics: Week 5: writing frame 'I know that... I know that...'
Week 6: writing frame 'A tradition in my family is... This tradition makes me feel...'

topics.name: Listening and Speaking
subtopics: Theme: Science is fun
Daily routine: greeting, theme song or rhyme with actions, open-ended question of the day, 4 vocabulary words a day and weekly sight words
Songs: 'I love science'; rainbow colours song
Vocabulary e.g. science, experiment, scientist, vaccine, virus, protect, rainbow, colours, raindrop, sunlight, research, curious
Sight words: milk, cows, get, sick; love, loves, learn, just

topics.name: Reading (Shared Reading)
subtopics: Week 7: predicts; makes evaluations; answers questions about the story (formal assessment)
Week 8: predicts; makes inferences; recounts the story

topics.name: Phonics
subtopics: Week 7: revises sounds from weeks 1-6; initial sound differentiation; says plurals (-s, -es) of pictured objects
Week 8: initial sounds; revises plurals; claps syllables in sight words (formal assessment)

topics.name: Writing
subtopics: Week 7: writing frame 'I want to invent... I want it to...'
Week 8: writing frame 'I feel curious about: 1... 2...'

topics.name: Consolidation and revision: Listening and Speaking
subtopics: Revises all songs and rhymes learnt this term
Oral description language game: riddles ('I have 2 legs, wings and a beak. What am I?')
Learners describe pictured objects for classmates to guess

topics.name: Consolidation and revision: Reading (Shared Reading)
subtopics: Predicts; makes inferences in first and second reads; recounts the story

topics.name: Consolidation and revision: Phonics
subtopics: Week 9: initial sounds, rhyming words and plurals
Week 10: revision of all phonics taught this year

topics.name: Consolidation and revision: Writing
subtopics: Week 9: makes a list of what they would like to buy for the holiday
Week 10: writing frame 'This holiday, I am going to...' with a drawing

sba: Listening and speaking (by week 9; rubric out of 7): expresses self in simple ways using short phrases and vocabulary taught (recounts part of a favourite big book story). Checklist: songs with actions, points to objects on instruction, identifies a person, animal or object from an oral description
Phonics oral (weeks 7-8; rubric out of 7): claps out syllables in words from the story. Checklist: initial sounds, rhyming words, plurals (-s, -es) aurally

Reading oral/practical (weeks 7-8; rubric out of 7): answers 5 simple literal questions about a Shared Reading story (orally or by circling pictures). Checklist: listens to stories, joins in choruses, acts out the story, identifies objects in pictures
Writing (observed, not recorded on SA-SAMS): draws a picture for a story; copies a caption for a picture
